scope.implemented: Create a standard button and use its visibility expression as a status indicator.
scope.deferred: Native object-library indicator lamp placement remains a future extension because its drag/place and property flow is separate from the verified standard-button path.

implementedWorkflow.name: window.indicator.add
safety: Refuses the default project unless --allow-original is supplied.
Writes only through the visible MCGS editor GUI.
Exports the copied project after save and verifies tokens in blob_strings.json.

entryRoute: Select user window index 2 by default.
Draw the button on the canvas at the requested rectangle.
Select tab index 3, the visibility property page.
Set the visibility expression Edit control.
Select visible-when-nonzero by default, or invisible-when-nonzero when requested.
notes: This workflow intentionally avoids direct writes to WndUser.lbObjects.
The standard-button route is enough for simple limit/action/conflict status displays because MCGS stores both the label and visibility expression in the window object blob.
The object-element library profile is retained as reference only until the native indicator lamp workflow is independently verified.
